verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              निवृत्ते भीमसेने च पाण्डवे च युधिष्ठिरे । वध्यमाने बले चापि मामके पाण्डुसृञ्जयैः ॥१॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said When Bhimasena and Pandu's Yudhishthira were fighting, when my soldiers were being killed by the Pandavas and Srinjayas, when my army was routed and dispirited tell me, O Sanjaya, what did the Kauravas do. son

verses.sanskrit: द्रवमाणे बलौघे च निरानन्दे मुहुर्मुहुः । किमकुर्वन्त कुरवस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व सञ्जय ॥२॥

सञ्जय उवाच।
              दृष्ट्वा भीमं महाबाहुं सूतपुत्रः प्रतापवान् । क्रोधरक्तेक्षणो राजन्भीमसेनमुपाद्रवत् ॥३॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Seeing the mighty-armed Bhima the valiant Karna, with eyes, reddened in anger, rushed towards him.

verses.sanskrit: तावकं तु बलं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनात्पराङ्मुखम् । यत्नेन महता राजन्पर्यवस्थापयद्बली ॥४॥
verses.english: Beholding your soldiers routed by Bhima the powerful Karna rallied them again with great exertion.

verses.sanskrit: व्यवस्थाप्य महाबाहुस्तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनीम् । प्रत्युद्ययौ तदा कर्णः पाण्डवान् युद्धदुर्मदान् ॥५॥
verses.english: Then Karna, that powerful bowman, that siniter of enemies, having arranged the troops in the from of a Makara, started against the Pandavas with the object of winning victory (over them).

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्युद्ययुस्तु राधेयं पाण्डवानां महारथाः । धुन्वानाः कार्मुकाण्याजौ विक्षिपन्तश्च सायकान् ॥६॥
verses.english: Having collected your son's force the largearmed Karna advanced against the heroic Pandavas invincible in battle. Drawing their bows and discharging arrows the great carwarriors of the Pandavas advanced against the son of Radha.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनः शिनेर्नप्ता शिखण्डी जनमेजयः । धृष्टद्युम्नश्च बलवान् सर्वे चापि प्रभद्रकाः ॥७॥
verses.english: Worked up with anger and desiring for victory Bhimasena, the grandson of Sini, Shikhandi Janamejaya, the powerful Dhristadyumna, all the Prabhadrakas and the Panchalas advanced furiously from all directions against your army.

verses.sanskrit: जिघांसन्तो नरव्याघ्राः समन्तात् तव वाहिनीम् । अभ्यद्रवन्त संक्रुद्धाः समरे जितकाशिनः ॥८॥
तथैव तावका राजन्पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम् । अभ्यद्रवन्त त्वरिता जिघांसन्तो महारथाः ॥९॥
verses.english: In the same way the powerful car-warriors of your host speedily advanced against the Pandava army desirous of killing them.

verses.sanskrit: रथनागाश्वकलिलं पत्तिध्वजसमाकुलम् । बभूव पुरुषव्याघ्र सैन्यमद्भुतदर्शनम् ॥१०॥
verses.english: The hosts, abounding in cars, elephants, the cavalry and infantry, looked exceedingly wonderful.

verses.sanskrit: शिखण्डी च ययौ कर्णं धृष्टद्युम्नः सुतं तव । दुःशासनं महाराज महत्या सेनया वृतम् ॥११॥
verses.english: Shikhandi rushed against Karna and Dhristadyumna, accompanied by a great force, proceeded against your son Dushasana.

verses.sanskrit: नकुलो वृषसेनं तु चित्रसेनं युधिष्ठिरः । उलूकं समरे राजन् सहदेवः समभ्ययात् ॥१२॥
verses.english: Nakula against Vrishasena and Yudhishthira advanced against Chitrasena; Sahadeva proceeded against Uluka in that battle. two ran

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिः शकुनिं चापि द्रौपदेयाश्च कौरवान् । अर्जुनं च रणे यत्तो द्रोणपुत्रो महारथः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Satyaki proceeded against Shakuni and the sons of Draupadi against other Kauravas. And the great car-warrior Drona's son proceeded against Arjuna in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: युधामन्युं महेष्वासं गौतमोऽभ्यपतद्रणे । कृतवर्मा च बलवानुत्तमौजसमाद्रवत् ॥१४॥
verses.english: Gautama encountered in battle the great bowman Yudhamanyu. And the powerful Kritavarma rushed against Uttamoujasa.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनः कुरून् सर्वान् पुत्रांश्च तव मारिष । सहानीकान्महाबाहुरेक एव न्यवारयत् ॥१५॥
verses.english: The large-armed Bhimasena alone withstood all your sons with their armies.

verses.sanskrit: शिखण्डी तु ततः कर्णं विचरन्तमभीतवत् । भीष्महन्ता महाराज वारयामास पत्रिभिः ॥१६॥
verses.english: Thereupon Shikhandi, the slayer of Bhishma, with winged arrows, obstructed Karna ranging fearlessly in the battle-field).

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिरुद्धस्ततः कर्णो रोषात् प्रस्फुरिताधरः । शिखण्डिनं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्भ्रुवोर्मध्येऽभ्यताडयत् ॥१७॥
verses.english: Thus obstructed and with his lips trembling in anger Karna struck Shikhandi on the forehead with three arrows.

verses.sanskrit: धारयंस्तु स तान्बाणाञ्शिखण्डी बह्वशोभत । राजतः पर्वतो यद्वत्त्रिभिः शृङ्गैरिवोत्थितैः ॥१८॥
verses.english: Carrying three arrows Shikhandi shone there like a silver mountain with three elevated summits.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासः सूतपुत्रेण संयुगे । कर्णं विव्याध समरे नवत्या निशितैः शरैः ॥१९॥
verses.english: Sorely wounded by Karna in that battle that great bowman struck him in return with ninety sharp arrows.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य कर्णो हयान् हत्वा सारथिं च त्रिभिः शरैः । उन्ममाथ ध्वजं चास्य क्षुरप्रेण महारथः ॥२०॥
verses.english: Having slain his horses and driver with three arrows the great car-warrior Karna struck down his standard with a razor-shaped arrow.

verses.sanskrit: हताश्वात्तु ततो यानादवप्लुत्य महारथः । शक्तिं चिक्षेप कर्णाय संक्रुद्धः शत्रुतापनः ॥२१॥
verses.english: Then jumping down from his horseless car that great car-warrior, the aggrandiser of his enemies, discharged a dart in anger at Karna.

verses.sanskrit: तां छित्त्वा समरे कर्णस्त्रिभिर्भारत सायकैः । शिखण्डिनमथाविध्यन्नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः ॥२२॥
verses.english: Cutting it off in battle with three arrows Karna struck Shikhandi with nine sharp arrows.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णचापच्युतान्बाणान्वर्जयंस्तु नरोत्तमः । अपयातस्ततस्तूर्णं शिखण्डी भृशविक्षतः ॥२३॥
verses.english: Avoiding arrows shot off Karna's bow Shikhandi, greatly wounded, quickly retreated from the field.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कर्णो महाराज पाण्डुसैन्यान्यशातयत् । तूलराशिं समासाद्य यथा वायुर्महाबलः ॥२४॥
verses.english: O king, then Karna fell on the Pandava army as the violent wind disperses a pack of cotton.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नो महाराज तव पुत्रेण पीडितः । दुःशासनं त्रिभिर्बाणैः प्रत्यविध्यत्स्तनान्तरे ॥२५॥
verses.english: Wounded by your son Dhristadyumna struck, in return, Dushasana on the breast with three arrows.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य दुःशासनो बाहुं सव्यं विव्याध मारिष । स तेन रुक्मपुङ्खेन भल्लेनानतपर्वणा ॥२६॥
verses.english: Then Dushasana struck the left arm of his enemy with a sharp gold feathered, winged arrows.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु निर्विद्धः शरं घोरममर्षणः । दुःशासनाय संक्रुद्धः प्रेषयामास भारत ॥२७॥
verses.english: Thus wounded and filled with terrible rage Dhristadyumna shot arrows at Dushasana.

verses.sanskrit: आपतन्तं महावेगं धृष्टद्युम्नसमीरितम् । शरैश्चिच्छेद पुत्रस्ते त्रिभिरेव विशांपते ॥२८॥
verses.english: O king, with three arrows your son cut-off the shaft discharged by Dhristadyumna which was about to fall with great force.

verses.sanskrit: अथापरैः सप्तदशैर्भल्लैः कनकभूषणैः । धृष्टद्युम्नं समासाद्य बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत् ॥२९॥
verses.english: Then approaching Dhristadyumna he struck him on the breast and two arms with seventeen other gold winged arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स पार्षतः क्रुद्धो धनुश्चिच्छेद मारिष । क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन तत उच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः ॥३०॥
verses.english: Then worked up with anger Prisata's son cut-off his bow with a sharp razor shaped arrow at which all his people shouted out.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यद्धनुरादाय पुत्रस्ते प्रहसन्निव । धृष्टद्युम्नं शरव्रातैः समन्तात्पर्यवारयत् ॥३१॥
verses.english: Your son, however, taking up another bow, smilingly covered Dhristadyumna with wounds of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: तव पुत्रस्य ते दृष्ट्वा विक्रमं सुमहात्मनः । व्यस्मयन्त रणे योधाः सिद्धाश्चाप्सरसां गणाः ॥३२॥
verses.english: Beholding the prowess of your high-souled son all the warriors in the field, Siddhas and Apsaras were filled surprise.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नं न पश्याम घटमानं महाबलम् । दुःशासनेन संरुद्धं सिंहेनेव महागजम् ॥३३॥
verses.english: We saw the highly powerful Dhristadyumna obstructed by Dushasana like a huge elephant checked by a lion.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सरथनागाश्वाः पञ्चालाः पाण्डुपूर्वज । सेनापतिं परीप्सन्तो रुरुधुस्तनयं तव ॥३४॥
verses.english: Then desirous of rescuing their generalissimo, O elder brother of Pandu, the Panchala car-warriors, elephants and horses surrounded your son.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तावकानां परैः सह । घोरं प्राणभृतां काले भीमरूपं परन्तप ॥३५॥
verses.english: O slayer of enemies, then ensued a dreadful and destructive encounter between your people and your enemy's host.

verses.sanskrit: नकुलं वृषसेनस्तु भित्त्वा पञ्चभिरायसैः । पितुः समीपे तिष्ठन्वै त्रिभिरन्यैरविध्यत ॥३६॥
verses.english: Standing by his father's side Vrishasena struck Nakula with five iron arrows and again wounded with three others.

verses.sanskrit: नकुलस्तु ततः शूरो वृषसेनं हसन्निव । नाराचेन सुतीक्ष्णेन विव्याध हृदये भृशम् ॥३७॥
verses.english: The heroic Nakula however smiling struck Vrishasena on the breast with a sharp Naracha.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता शत्रुणा शत्रुकर्षण । शत्रुं विव्याध विंशत्या स च तं पञ्चभिः शरैः ॥३८॥
verses.english: Thus wounded greatly by his powerful enemy that grinder of his enemies struck his adversary with twenty five arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शरसहस्रेण तावुभौ पुरुषर्षभौ । अन्योन्यमाच्छादयतामथोऽभज्यत वाहिनी ॥३९॥
verses.english: Those two foremost of men covered each other with thousands of arrows at which their respective battalions broke.

verses.sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा प्रद्रुतां सेनां धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सूतजः । निवारयामास बलाद‌नुसृत्य विशांपते ॥४०॥
verses.english: Seeing Duryodhana's soldiers quickly flying away Karna, O king, prevented them with force.

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्ते तु ततः कर्णे नकुलः कौरवान् ययौ । कर्णपुत्रस्तु समरे हित्वा नकुलमेव तु ॥४१॥
verses.english: After Karna's departure Nakula proceeded against the Kauravas. Avoiding Nakula in battle Karna's son quickly went to Karna, who was guarding the passage of his chariot.

verses.sanskrit: जुगोप चक्रं त्वरितो राधेयस्यैव मारिष । उलूकस्तु रणे क्रुद्धः सहदेवेन वारितः ॥४२॥
verses.english: Angry Uluka was restrained by Sahadeva in battle. Having killed his four horse the powerful Sahadeva dispatched his charioteer to the abode of Yama.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश्वांश्चतुरो हत्वा सहदेवः प्रतापवान् । सारथिं प्रेषयामास यमस्य सदनं प्रति ॥४३॥
उलूकस्तु ततो यानादवप्लुत्य विशांपते । त्रिगर्तानां बलं तूर्णं जगाम पितृनन्दनः ॥४४॥
verses.english: Then leaping down from his car O king, Uluka, the joy of his sire, soon advanced against the host of Trigarttas.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिः शकुनिं विद्ध्वा विंशत्या निशितैः शरैः । ध्वजं चिच्छेद भल्लेन सौबलस्य हसन्निव ॥४५॥
verses.english: Having pierced Shakuni with twenty sharp arrows Satyaki, as if smiling, struck down the standard of Subala's son with his dart.

verses.sanskrit: सौबलस्तस्य समरे क्रुद्धो राजन् प्रतापवान् । विदार्य कवचं भूयो ध्वजं चिच्छेद काञ्चनम् ॥४६॥
verses.english: O king, the powerful son of Subala too, worked up with anger, cutting off his coat of mail, again sundered his golden standard.

verses.sanskrit: तथैनं निशितैर्बाणैः सात्यकिः प्रत्यविध्यत । सारथिं च महाराज त्रिभिरेव समार्पयत् ॥४७॥
verses.english: Then Satyaki pierced him in return with sharpened arrows and also pierced his charioteer with three arrows.

verses.sanskrit: अथास्य वाहांस्त्वरितः शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम् । ततोऽवप्लुत्य सहसा शकुनिर्भरतर्षभ ॥४८॥
verses.english: Then quickly dispatched his horses to the abode of Yama with arrows. Then ( king, jumping down all on a sudden from his own car Shakuni quickly got on Uluka's car.

verses.sanskrit: आरुरोह रथं तूर्णमुलूकस्य महात्मनः । अपोवाहाथ शीघ्रं स शैनेयाद्युद्धशालिनः ॥४९॥
सात्यकिस्तु रणे राजंस्तावकानामनीकिनीम् । अभिदुद्राव वेगेन ततोऽनीकमभज्यत ॥५०॥
verses.english: Then that hero, expert in fighting, soon took away Sini's grandson. Then O king, Satyaki, with great force, advanced against your army at which they were all routed.

verses.sanskrit: शैनेयशरसंछन्नं तव सैन्यं विशांपते । भेजे दश दिशस्तूर्णं न्यपतच्च गतासुवत् ॥५१॥
verses.english: Covered with arrows shot by Sini's grandson your soldiers, O king, fled away in all directions and dropped down dead.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनं तव सुतो वारयामास संयुगे । तं तु भीमो मुहूर्तेन व्यश्वसूतरथध्वजम् ॥५२॥
verses.english: Your son obstructed Bhimasena in battle. Bhima however, in a moment, deprived him of his horses, charioteer, car and standards. His men, O king, were highly pleased.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रे लोकेश्वरं तत्र तेनातुष्यन्त वै जनाः । ततोऽपायान्नृपस्तत्र भीमसेनस्य गोचरात् ॥५३॥
कुरुसैन्यं ततः सर्वं भीमसेनमुपाद्रवत् । तत्र नादो महानासीद्भीमसेनं जिघांसताम् ॥५४॥
verses.english: The king soon fled away from Bhimasena's view. Then the entire Kuru army rushed towards Bhimasena. And desirous of killing Bhima they set up a terrible shout.

verses.sanskrit: युधामन्युः कृपं विद्ध्वा धनुरस्याशु चिच्छिदे । अथान्यद्धनुरादाय कृपः शस्त्रभृतां वरः ॥५५॥
verses.english: Having struck Kripa Yudhamanyu soon cut-off his bow. But Kripa, the foremost of the wielders of arms, taking up another bow struck down on earth Yudhamanyu's standard, charioteer and umbrella. the great car-warrior Yudhamanyu fled away on his car.

verses.sanskrit: युधामन्योर्ध्वजं सूतं छत्रं चापातयत्क्षितौ । ततोऽपायाद्रथेनैव युधामन्युर्महारथः ॥५६॥
उत्तमौजाश्च हार्दिक्यं भीमं भीमपराक्रमम् । छादयामास सहसा मेघो वृष्ट्येव पर्वतम् ॥५७॥
verses.english: Uttamouja soon covered Hirdika's son Bhima of dreadful prowess like showers covering a mountain.

verses.sanskrit: तद्युद्धमासीत्सुमहद्धोररूपं परन्तप । यादृशं न मया युद्धं दृष्टपूर्वं विशांपते ॥५८॥
verses.english: Then O slayer of enemies, that battle became highly dreadful the like of which had never been seen by me before, O king.

verses.sanskrit: कृतवर्मा ततो राजन्नुत्तमौजसमाहवे । हृदि विव्याध सहसा रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् ॥५९॥
verses.english: Then Kritavarma, in that battle, O king, all on a sudden struck Uttamouja on the breast at which the latter sank down on his car.

verses.sanskrit: सारथिस्तमपोवाह रथेन रथिनां वरम् । कुरुसैन्यं ततः सर्वं भीमसेनमुपाद्रवत् ॥६०॥
verses.english: His charioteer however carried away that foremost of car-warriors. Then the Kuru army surrounded Bhimasena from all sides.

verses.sanskrit: दुःशासनः सौबलश्च गजानीकेन पाण्डवम् । महता परिवार्यैव क्षुद्रकैरभ्यताडयत् ॥६१॥
verses.english: With a huge elephant force Dushasana and Subala's son surrounded Pandu's son and began to assail him with small arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ततो भीमः शरशतैर्दुर्योधनममर्षणम् । विमुखीकृत्य तरसा गजानीकमुपाद्रवत् ॥६२॥
verses.english: Thereupon making the angry Duryodhana retreat from the battle-field with a hundred arrows Bhima quickly advanced against the elephant force.

verses.sanskrit: तमापतन्तं सहसा गजानीकं वृकोदरः ।  दृष्ट्वैव सुभृशं क्रुद्धो दिव्यमस्त्रमुदैरयत् ॥६३॥
verses.english: Beholding that elephant force advance against him all on a sudden Vrikodara, worked up greatly with anger, invited celestial weapons.

verses.sanskrit: गजैर्गजानभ्यहनद्वज्रेणेन्द्र इवासुरान् । ततोऽन्तरिक्षं बाणौघै शलभैरिव पादपम् ॥६४॥
verses.english: He then struck elephants with elephants as Indra assailed the Asuras. Killing the elephants in battle Vrikodara covered the sky with arrows as a swarm of insects cover a flame.

verses.sanskrit: छादयामास समरे गजान्निघ्नन् वृकोदरः । ततः कुञ्जरयूथानि समेतानि सहस्रशः ॥६५॥
व्यधमत्तरसा भीमो मेघसङ्घानिवानिलः । सुवर्णजालापिहिता मणिजालैश्च कुञ्जराः ॥६६॥
verses.english: As the wind scatters a collection of clouds so Bhima dispersed and killed those elephants collected there in thousands.

verses.sanskrit: रेजुरभ्यधिकं संख्ये विद्युत्वन्त इवाम्बुदाः । ते वध्यमाना भीमेन गजा राजन्विदुद्रुवुः ॥६७॥
verses.english: Covered with net-works of gold and gems the elephants looked greatly beautiful like clouds charged with lightning.

verses.sanskrit: केचिद्विभिन्नहृदयाः कुञ्जरा न्यपतन् भुवि । पतितैर्निपतद्भिश्च गजैर्हेमविभूषितैः ॥६८॥
verses.english: Assailed by Bhima, O king, the elephants fled away on all sides. Some, cut to their hearts, fell down on earth.

verses.sanskrit: अशोभत मही तत्र विशीर्णैरिव पर्वतैः । दीप्ताभै रत्नवद्भिश्च पतितैर्गजयोधिभिः ॥६९॥
verses.english: With elephants adorned with gold fallen there the earth appeared as if strewn with shattered mountains.

verses.sanskrit: रराज भूमिः पतितैः क्षीणपुण्यैरिव ग्रहैः । ततो भिन्नकटा नागा भिन्नकुम्भकरास्तथा ॥७०॥
verses.english: With fallen elephant warriors, shining and adorned with jewels and the earth shone beautiful as if covered with planets dropped for the wane of virtue.

verses.sanskrit: दुद्रुवुः शतशः संख्ये भीमसेनशराहताः । केचिद्वमन्तो रुधिरं भयार्ताः पर्वतोपमाः ॥७१॥
verses.english: With their temples, frontal globes and trunks maimed the elephants, struck by Bhimasena's arrows, fled away in hundreds in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: व्यद्रवञ्छरविद्धाङ्गा धातुचित्रा इवाचलाः । महाभुजगसङ्काशौ चन्दनागुरुरूषितौ ॥७२॥
verses.english: With their limbs wounded with arrows, stricken with fear and vomiting blood, some, huge like mountains, fled away like mountains adorned with metals.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यं भीमसेनस्य धातुर्विक्षिपतो भुजौ । तस्य ज्यातलनिर्घोषं श्रुत्वाऽशनिसमस्वनम् ॥७३॥
verses.english: There they saw the two arms of Bhimasena, holding bows, pasted with sandal and Aguru and resembling two huge serpents.

verses.sanskrit: विमुञ्चन्तः शकृन्मूत्रं गजाः प्रादुद्रुवुर्भृशम् । भीमसेनस्य तत् कर्म राजन्नेकस्य धीमतः । निघ्नतः सर्वभूतानि रुद्रस्येव च निर्बभौ ॥७४॥
verses.english: That feat, of the intelligent Bhimasena who fought single-handed, resembled that of Rudra while destroying all creatures.
